hotels.title: Bali: All-Villa Jimbaran Hideaway with Spa, Ice Bath & Dining
hotels.description: ASAI Village sits in leafy Jimbaran, one of Bali's most tranquil pockets, just moments from the serene stretch of Jimbaran Beach. It is an all-villa sanctuary, with some offering direct access to the resort pool from the terrace, while others have secluded private pools. Lush tropical gardens weave between open-air pavilions, warm timber and natural stone, a landscape that feels ancient and alive. ASAI Spa draws you deeper into that stillness, offering treatments rooted in Balinese tradition, along with a sauna and ice bath. ASAI Village is built for those who want beauty and ease in equal measure. A crystal-clear 25-meter pool stretches beneath an open sky, surrounded by sun-soaked loungers and swaying greenery. The onsite ASAI Cafe serves shakshuka, salmon croissants, and juicy rib-eye in chic surroundings. Those craving a little action can hop on the complimentary shuttle to Jimbaran Padel Club, just a five-minute drive away.

hotels.title: Beachfront Jumeirah Bali Water Palace-Inspired Luxury with Only Pool Villas
hotels.description: Secluded luxury and endless ocean panoramas await at the all-pool villa, five-star Jumeirah Bali, a romantic retreat surrounded by a dramatic coastline, native jungle and lush rice paddies. Perfectly poised on a clifftop on Bali's south coast, overlooking the Indian Ocean, this intimate Hindu water palace-inspired retreat will make you feel like royalty. Let your expectations be met and then surpassed as you luxuriate in the Indian Ocean infinity pool, dine on tantalising open-grill dining at the water-view Akasa restaurant and make the most of an Uluwatu location that's the envy of many.

hotels.title: Jimbaran Raffles Private Pool Villas with Three Restaurants & World-Class Spa
hotels.description: It doesn't get much more opulent than a Raffles retreat, and this sprawling Jimbaran paradise is no exception. Savour multi award-winning service and five-star luxuries surrounded by secluded tropical gardens and rolling hills, all just steps from a pristine stretch of beach. Dine at the organic Rumari restaurant or enjoy a casual pizza by the ocean at Loloan Beach Bar & Grill, sip craft cocktails at the signature Writers Bar and walk into a world of calm at the onsite spa. Further afar, explore the nearby Uluwatu Temple, a Balinese sea temple with breathtaking cliffside views.

hotels.title: Bali Five-Star Jimbaran Private Pool Villas
hotels.description: Experience the pinnacle of secluded romance at Cross Bali Breakers Resort in Jimbaran, a five-star sanctuary ideally located on Bali’s pristine southern peninsula. Nestled amid lush forest, this luxury hotel is surrounded by rich Balinese jungle but just 10 minutes from the waves of Kuta's famed Balangan Beach and the cool, calm waters of Dreamland Beach. When you're not relaxing beachside, enjoy the privacy of your very own villa, complete with private pool. Make the most of the resort’s luxurious amenities, which include a sunken swim-up bar, rooftop pool, adults-only serenity pool, state-of-the-art fitness centre and full-service spa. Enjoy an all-day culinary experience at Point Break restaurant, grab a cup of Jimbaran's finest coffee at The Tube Bar, or swim up and enjoy quality snacks and drinks at the Sunken Pool Bar. In the evening, sample creative cocktails overlooking the resort at the unbeatable Hang Loose Bar.
